Third-party model assets (NOT bundled):
PrismML Ternary Bonsai 2 4B and 2B GGUF — Apache-2.0, per each pinned model card.
Source repositories/revisions/hashes: model-manifest.json.
Full 4B upstream license/notice included in research/ of source distribution.
The model weights are fetched only by explicit preparation and are not part of
this app deployment or source archive. No vision projector is used.

Third-party inference runtime (NOT bundled):
WebML Community / ternary-bonsai-2-hermes-webgpu, commit
621e20782f208660f4f58283c2ce58430020f243, qwen35-vision-Kzp5MMIJ.js.
The Space metadata has no runtime-specific license statement. Its
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md describes Hermes UI references and fonts, which this app
does not use, and must not be treated as a blanket runtime license.
The runtime is not redistributed or relicensed by this project. Explicit initial
preparation fetches the exact pinned upstream bundle into the user's local
storage. Upstream license clarification is required before bundling or further
redistributing that runtime. This is a stated unresolved licensing issue.
This project does not treat the Apache license of @huggingface/kernels or the
model weights as a license for the complete independently built runtime bundle.

GBrain design reference only: no GBrain source code copied.
No external font, image, analytics, framework or UI package is bundled.
